description: Learn about the types of Microsoft Azure support resources that are available to you. View Azure support plans and options to get started right away.

plans.name: Developer
plans.desc: If you’re using Azure in a nonproduction environment or just trying it out, choose the Developer plan to get an initial response to your Azure technical support requests within one business day.
plans.response: Initial response within one business day

plans.name: Standard
plans.desc: When you’re running a production workload on Azure, get Azure technical support initial response times between one hour and one business day, based on case severity, with the Standard plan.
plans.response: Initial response between one hour and one business day, based on case severity

plans.name: Professional Direct
plans.desc: If you need faster response times, advisory services, and high-severity incident escalation management from a collaborative management pool, choose Professional Direct (ProDirect) support.
plans.response: Faster response times, advisory services, and escalation management

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.desc: If you need company-wide support across Azure and other Microsoft technologies, consider enterprise support.
plans.response: Company-wide support across Azure and other Microsoft technologies
